headline: OPEC Plus Holds Oil Production Steady as U.S.-Iran Strikes Resume
context: The decision on Sunday by the cartel of oil-producing nations and some of its allies came after the resumption of U.S. and Iranian military strikes in the Persian Gulf.

sources.name: The New York Times
